title: vulnops client contacts
description: Who receives the client's alerts (contacts.yaml of the client project), with their role.

role.description: Free text: RSSI, chef du SOC, CERT, DSI, responsable d'exploitation...

receive.description: Alert levels this contact receives. Default: both.

active.description: false keeps the contact listed without sending to it. Default: true.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language of the sheet this contact receives (since v0.17.1). Default: en, the reference; another language is a translation validated by an analyst.
